svg.title: Workflow 5: Renewals: the 2021 wave, then every test after
svg.text: Renewals: the 2021 wave, then every test after
Landlords had to test by April 2021. Five years on, Wrenfield’s own archive held the list of who’s due.
One email each with their list (B2B)
Letters by post, with an opt-out
£29.9k of re-tests booked, plus £27.4k of expected remedial work. Letters and postage: ≈£240.
From now on: every new EICR stores its due date, and asks at booking whether the landlord wants a reminder.
Texts and emails to individuals need
Post is outside PECR; UK GDPR still applies,
so: legitimate interests and an opt-out
Email or text private landlords without
A PDF can’t be read: on Lisa’s list to check
Sold or moved: marked, never contacted
One-off: Claude Batch API over the archive
